question: Were the Houses of Brannoch and Rannoch allied, and which northern claims are direct rather than graph-adjacent?

typed_answer.answer: There is no evidence that the Houses of Brannoch and Rannoch were allied. Their co-mention in the northern-district collection is merely a collection adjacency, which does not establish an alliance, conflict, kinship, or participation in the same event. Regarding the northern claims, the direct claims (rather than graph-adjacent leads) are: 1) Factor Iven directed removals on the Rannoch Estate in Glen Mora in 1841; 2) the House of Brannoch supported the Northwatch companies in 1718; 3) Mara Quill reported hardship regarding the 1841 Glen Mora removals; and 4) Elian Voss judged those removals as lawful.
